description: PLATEAU's Tokushima i-UR Urban Function file read and written back with uro and urf 3.1 listed in adeSchemas: each urf:DistrictPlan keeps its nested urf:DistrictDevelopmentPlan objects under urf:districtDevelopmentPlan, the wrapper the source used, rather than urf:target, which comes first in the content model and also accepts any city object. Both are schema-valid, so only the tree comparison catches it. The case ships a validation.xsd so check-citygml-schema validates it against i-UR. New-world only: the legacy writer flattens nested objects.
